description: Create professional landing page with hero, features, how-it-works, benefits, FAQ sections, and router integration
steps: Create src/pages/LandingPage.tsx with sections: Header (logo, nav, CTA), Hero (headline + dashboard preview), Features (6 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Benefits, FAQ accordion, Footer
Create src/Router.tsx with routes: / → LandingPage, /calculator → CalculatorPage (renamed App.tsx)
Rename App.tsx to src/pages/CalculatorPage.tsx and update imports
Update src/main.tsx to use Router instead of directly rendering App
Landing page design uses navy (#0f2744), white, emerald (#2d7d46) palette
Implement mobile-responsive navigation with hamburger menu
Dashboard preview shows sample INR values using formatINR
All navigation links use react-router-dom Link component
acceptance_criteria: Landing page loads at root URL (/), calculator at /calculator
Mobile navigation works (hamburger menu on small screens)
All sections are visually polished and professional
Dashboard preview shows realistic INR values
Navigation links work correctly between pages
verification: Run `npm run dev` and verify landing page loads at /
Test responsive behavior on different screen sizes
Run `npm run build` - build must succeed
findings: All steps completed successfully. Build succeeded with no errors. Tests passed (14/14). Created responsive landing page with all required sections. Navigation works correctly between landing page and calculator. Used existing currency formatting utility for INR values.
